content:
Apple TV today launched a brand-new original film: the action comedy *Mayday*, starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh.

Apple TV subscribers can stream *Mayday* for free. The story follows Troy (played by Reynolds) infiltrating Russia during the Cold War, where KGB agent Nikolai (played by Branagh) unexpectedly becomes his ally.

Troy originally expected to be captured and executed, but Nikolai, who sympathises with American culture, actively helps him leave Russia. *Mayday* subverts every Cold War thriller cliché and heavily references 1980s films such as *Top Gun*.

If you are looking for a light-hearted Friday night action comedy, *Mayday* may be just the ticket, particularly if you enjoy Ryan Reynolds' signature style. The film has also received strong reviews from critics, currently holding an 84% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

*Mayday* is now available on Apple TV. Viewers can watch it via the Apple TV app on iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Mac, Android, Windows, Roku, Amazon Fire Stick, Xbox, PlayStation and other devices, or stream it through a browser at tv.apple.com.

*Mayday* is Apple's latest original film. The platform now offers over 330 original series and films in total.

Other titles debuting this month include the new series *Last Seen*, the sixth season of *Slow Horses*, and the new comedy *Brothers*. Other notable new releases include *Matchbox* and *Tenzing*, which will debut in October.
